nodes.summary: Let $r \le N$ be natural numbers such that every prime divisor of $\binom{N}{r}$ is at most $r$. Then $\prod_{p=0}^{r} p^{v_p(\binom{N}{r})} = \binom{N}{r}$, where $v_p(m)$ is the exponent of $p$ in the prime factorization of $m$ (zero when $p$ is not prime).
nodes.title: Truncating the prime factorization of a binomial coefficient

nodes.summary: Let $N \ge 6$ and $r$ be natural numbers with $2r \le N$ (hence $r \le N$) such that every prime divisor of $\binom{N}{r}$ is at most $r$. Write $P(m)$ for the product of all primes $p \le m$ and let $L = \lfloor \log_2 N \rfloor$. Then $\binom{N}{r} \le \prod_{k=1}^{L} a_k$, where $a_1 = P(\lfloor N/3 \rfloor)$ and $a_k = P(\lfloor N^{1/k} \rfloor)$ for $k \ge 2$.
nodes.title: Erdős layer bound with a one-third first layer

nodes.summary: Let $0 < N$ and $r \le N$ be natural numbers such that every prime divisor of $\binom{N}{r}$ is at most $r$. Write $P(m)$ for the product of all primes $p \le m$ and let $L = \lfloor \log_2 N \rfloor$. Then $\binom{N}{r} \le \prod_{k=1}^{L} a_k$, where $a_1 = P(r)$ and $a_k = P(\lfloor N^{1/k} \rfloor)$ for $k \ge 2$.
nodes.title: Erdős layer bound for binomial coefficients without large prime factors

nodes.summary: Let $0 < N$ and $r \le N$ be natural numbers such that every prime divisor of $\binom{N}{r}$ is at most $r$. Write $P(m)$ for the product of all primes $p \le m$ and let $L = \lfloor \log_2 N \rfloor$. Then $\binom{N}{r} \le \prod_{k=1}^{L} P(\lfloor N^{1/k} \rfloor)$.
nodes.title: Erdős root-layer bound for binomial coefficients without large prime factors

nodes.summary: Let $0 < N$ and $r \le N$ be natural numbers such that every prime divisor of $\binom{N}{r}$ is at most $r$. Then $\binom{N}{r} \le N^{\lfloor r/2 \rfloor + 1}$.
nodes.title: Half-exponent bound for binomial coefficients without large prime factors

nodes.summary: Let $0 < N$ and $r \le N$ be natural numbers such that every prime divisor of $\binom{N}{r}$ is at most $r$. Then $\binom{N}{r} \le N^{\pi(r)}$, where $\pi(r)$ is the number of primes $p \le r$.
nodes.title: Prime-counting bound for binomial coefficients without large prime factors

nodes.summary: Let $0 < N$ and $2 \le r \le N$ be natural numbers such that every prime divisor of $\binom{N}{r}$ is at most $r$. Then $\binom{N}{r} \le N^{r-1}$.
nodes.title: Elementary power bound for binomial coefficients without large prime factors

nodes.summary: Let $0 < N$ and $38 \le r \le N$ be natural numbers such that every prime divisor of $\binom{N}{r}$ is at most $r$. Then $\binom{N}{r} \le N^{\lfloor 3r/8 \rfloor}$.
nodes.title: Three-eighths exponent bound for binomial coefficients without large prime factors

fully_proved.label: fully proved

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.
